Some of the information in the comments here is inaccurate. It appears they’ve eliminated commissions, for all self-directed brokerage customers, on regularly traded equities (stocks, mutual funds, ETF/ETNs), and the $4.95 commission of yesteryear now only applies to options trades.
With the acquisition of BTIG, they might also be gradually moving to full self-clearing operations, rather than the quasi-omnibus model through NFS that they have currently.
